note: Code-side mapping of every attraction to ONE primary theme (UI grouping only; the solver never sees themes). backend/tests/test_themes.py fails if an attraction or category is unmapped, and docs/design/themes-inventory.md is generated from this file by backend/scripts/make_theme_inventory.py.

category_notes.market: Default Food & drink (food markets). A craft or souvenir market is overridden to Shopping below.
category_notes.district: Only Akihabara (an electronics and retail district), so Shopping.
category_notes.mall: Only Jewel Changi (a mall with a garden attraction): primary theme Shopping.
category_notes.neighbourhood: Default Sightseeing (heritage streets). A shopping street is overridden below.
category_notes.architecture: Dongdaemun Design Plaza is a landmark building (it also has shops): primary theme Sightseeing.

central_market_kl.why: A handicraft and souvenir market, not a food market.

insadong.why: A street known for craft, art and tea shops; its category is neighbourhood.
